title: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank posts higher Q2 profit, beats estimates
summary: Net impairment charges fell 29% on year to AED143 million
thbAction: Map the news to THB's provider CRM for referral growth, patient lifecycle engagement, and multi-facility relationship management across hospital and provider networks.
contentHtml:
An exterior view of Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank (ADIB). Image courtesy: WAM

Net impairment charges fell 29% on year to AED143 million

Staff Writer ,  ZAWYA

Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank (ADIB) reported a Q2 net profit of AED1.9 billion ($517.4 million), up 8% year-on-year (YoY), driven by growth in funded income that lifted operating revenue.
